name: Hormander linear PDE
summary: Existence and regularity for general PDE are proved by Fourier and distribution methods.

name: Mathematical economics via fixed points
summary: Arrow-Debreu equilibrium existence by fixed-point theorem.

name: Network flows and combinatorial optimisation
summary: Max-flow min-cut ties graph theory to LP duality (Ford-Fulkerson, Edmonds).

name: Hirzebruch Riemann-Roch
summary: Characteristic classes expressed Euler characteristic of bundles.

name: KAM theory: stability of Hamiltonian systems
summary: Kolmogorov, Arnold and Moser show that most quasi-periodic motions of perturbed integrable Hamiltonian systems survive, using an iterative scheme that beats small divisors.

name: Nash: hard implicit function theorems and isometric embedding
summary: Nash solved the isometric embedding problem with a smoothing iteration that overcomes loss of derivatives, a method later extended by Moser.

name: Modularity of elliptic curves and Fermat's Last Theorem
summary: A counterexample to Fermat would give an elliptic curve contradicting modularity, and modularity of semistable curves is proved with Galois deformation theory and Hecke algebras.

name: Fermi-Pasta-Ulam and solitons
summary: Numerical experiments lead to the soliton concept.

name: Coherent sheaves (FAC)
summary: Sheaf cohomology was imported into algebraic varieties over Zariski topology.

name: Abelian categories and derived functors (Tohoku)
summary: A common axiomatic framework unified derived functors for modules and sheaves.
